calibration_sources: Thinking Machines Lab — Defeating Nondeterminism in LLM Inference (Batch-Invariant RMSNorm, MatMul & Fixed Split-Size FlashAttention)
vLLM / SGLang Deterministic Batch-Invariant Kernel & Per-Request Philox Seeded Sampling Architecture
IEEE-754 Floating-Point Non-Associativity in Split-K GEMM, Split-KV PagedAttention & NVLS Multicast AllReduce

workload_baseline.request_profile: 4,096 input tokens + 512 output tokens, temperature=0.0 / seed=42 across BS=1..64

tiers.name: Tier 1: Default Dynamic Continuous Batching (Split-K GEMM + Dynamic Split-KV FlashDecode + NVLS/Ring Auto-Switch)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 1: 默认动态连续批处理 (动态 Split-K 矩阵乘 + 动态分块数 Split-KV 注意力 + 通信自动切换)
tiers.mechanism: cuBLAS switches Split-K / tile sizes by batch M; FlashDecode fixes num_splits by free SMs; NCCL switches Tree/Ring/NVLS

tiers.name: Tier 2: Naive Serial Determinism (Lock max_num_seqs=1 + torch.use_deterministic_algorithms + Atomic-Free Workspace)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 2: 粗暴串行确定性 (强锁 BS=1 禁用连续批处理 + PyTorch 全局确定性标志)
tiers.mechanism: Forces batch_size=1 so every request sees identical kernel shapes and reduction order, destroying GPU Tensor Core utilization

tiers.name: Tier 3: Batch-Invariant Kernels (Fixed-Split-Size=256 FlashDecode + Fixed-Tile K-Tree GEMM + Deterministic RMSNorm)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 3: 批大小不变算子库 (固定切块大小 Split-Size=256 FlashDecode + 固定 K 维归约树 GEMM + 独立行 RMSNorm)
tiers.mechanism: Replaces fixed split-count with fixed KV split-size=256; disables Split-K atomics; enforces fixed binary reduction trees independent of batch M

tiers.name: Tier 4: Full-Stack 0-ULP Deterministic Engine (Batch-Invariant Kernels + Fixed-Tree TP AllReduce + Per-Req Philox Gumbel-Max + Prefix-Invariant RoPE)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 4: 全栈 0-ULP 逐比特确定性推理引擎 (批不变算子 + 固定序 TP AllReduce + 请求绑定 Philox 采样 + 前缀缓存不变位置编码)
tiers.mechanism: Combines Batch-Invariant RMSNorm/GEMM/FlashDecode with fixed-order TP AllReduce (bypassing non-deterministic switch/NVLS multicast) and per-request Philox RNG

batch_perturbation.root_cause: cuBLAS switches skinny-M GEMV kernel to Tensor Core MMA tile at M>=4
FlashDecode dynamic num_splits changes from 8 splits/seq (BS=1) to 2 splits/seq (BS=32)

batch_perturbation.condition: BS=1 (Isolated) vs BS=64 + Chunked Prefill Piggyback
batch_perturbation.root_cause: Prefill+Decode fused token batch alters GEMM tile selection & NVLS multicast arrival order

batch_perturbation.condition: Prefix Cache Miss (0% Hit) vs Prefix Cache Hit (80% Hit)
batch_perturbation.root_cause: Chunked prefill boundary vs cached KV blocks alters causal tile reduction tree unless split-size is fixed
